params.body:
Follow-up to #182 (token cache): the login should not be in a page render at all.

- RealGarantService::isConfigured(): consents accepted and the three credentials filled, database only. VehicleRealGarantService::isConfiguredAndValid() adds the vehicle check.
- StockListController::detail and the StocklistBrowser render use those instead of isConnected(): no HTTP leaves the house while a page renders.
- The warranty block already fetched its options over AJAX (real-garant.show). That endpoint now does the login; when it fails it answers 204 and the page removes the section, so a dead RealGarant never shows an empty frame.
params.title: RealGarant login out of the page render
